Use case: precise-object-edit. One native high-definition square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA game sprite, no sheet. Image 1 is edit target and exact geometry/arm ownership reference; image 2 definitive character identity for costume only; image 3 approved PRIMARY bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style.
Precisely repair ONLY the right hand's grip in image 1, EAST hit compression frame 02/06. Keep this exact crouch, head, face, feet, waist, sleeves, fan position and scale. The near anatomical RIGHT hand currently touches the left fan edge instead of holding the hinge. Move just the right forearm end/wrist and hand a small distance to screen-right so its palm wraps directly around the folding fan's black pivot/hinge where all ribs converge. Fingers curl around that hinge and thumb presses the opposite side with an unmistakable secure grip. The handle must emerge from the bottom of the closed hand; the fan's small jade bead/tassel hangs from that handle immediately below the hand. Near sleeve still connects to the same right shoulder and right hand. The other far hand remains empty behind the waist. Do not move the feet, fan face, head, canvas framing or change the low compressed pose.
Preserve navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise-gold ornament/blue tassel, blue/ivory/gold scholar robe, cloud-wave patterns and ivory-blue dragon fan. Exactly two arms/hands/legs/boots. Same face identity, proportions, alpha-edge quality and full-body margins. True transparent background, no UI/text/labels, no shadow/floor, no particles/effects, no motion blur. No mirroring or pose-copy substitute.
